module: Third-party LuaSocket library (Diego Nehab): common subsystem of the SMTP/FTP text protocols ("Telnet-like Protocol"). `connect` opens a TCP connection and returns an object whose methods read the server's three-digit numeric-code responses (multiline responses included) and send commands. Used by socket.smtp.
notes: The object returned by connect exposes: check(ok), command(cmd, arg), send(data), receive(pat), source(source, step), sink(snk, pat), getfd, dirty, getcontrol and close.
`check(ok)` accepts a Lua pattern (e.g. "2.."), a list of patterns, or a function (code, response); returns the numeric code and the text, or nil and the response if the code does not match.
Code bug: the `sink` method uses an undefined variable `c` (it should use self.c); it fails if called.

TIMEOUT.desc: Default timeout of network operations in seconds (60).

connect.desc: Creates a socket (create or socket.tcp), sets the timeout, connects and returns the control object. On failure, closes the socket and returns nil and the error.
